content.short: Decaf is a Solana-based payments app for accepting card, bank and USDC payments and cashing out locally.
content.description: Decaf is a self-custody payments app built to bring stablecoins to consumers and merchants, with a strong focus on Latin America. Through shareable payment links and a simple wallet, users and businesses accept card, bank transfer and USDC payments across more than 180 countries, spend through a virtual Visa card, and cash out to local bank accounts or in cash. Decaf runs on Solana and hides blockchain complexity behind an easy interface aimed at remote workers, freelancers, creators and merchants who want an alternative to PayPal and Stripe. It pairs consumer wallets with merchant acceptance and low-cost payouts.
